issue.title: Correctly set search quote analyzer for keyword fields

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Keyword fields with `split_queries_on_whitespace=true` were also setting
whitespace analyzers to be used for quoted queries.  Instead, keyword
fields should always set their searchQuoteAnalyzer to be the same as the
index-time normalizer.

Fixes #68313
